objects.description: Enumeration of JSON-like value types used by tinygltf::Value to tag stored data.
Parsing strictness level for TinyGLTF. Permissive accepts some non-conformant data; Strict enforces the spec more tightly.

A lightweight JSON-like variant/value class used to store extras and extensions and other dynamic data. Supports bool, int, double, string, binary, array, object. Provides typed getters, query helpers, and comparison.

objects.definition: using ColorValue = std::array<double, 4>;
objects.description: Fixed-length RGBA color representation as 4 doubles.
Legacy material parameter holder used for backward compatibility. Can store scalar, string, number arrays and texture-related properties. Prefer newer dedicated material fields.

objects.definition: typedef std::map<std::string, Parameter> ParameterMap;
objects.description: Mapping from parameter name to legacy Parameter for materials.

objects.definition: typedef std::map<std::string, Value> ExtensionMap;
objects.description: JSON-like object map for storing glTF extensions by name to arbitrary Value.
Links an animation sampler to a target node and path (translation, rotation, scale, weights). Stores extras and extensions for the channel and target.
Defines interpolation from input accessor to output accessor for an animation, with interpolation mode (LINEAR/STEP/CUBICSPLINE).
A glTF animation consisting of channels and samplers, optional name, extras and extensions.
Describes skeleton skinning: joints, inverse bind matrices accessor, and optional skeleton root. Includes extras/extensions.
Texture sampler state (min/mag filter, wrap modes). -1 indicates undefined filter per glTF spec.
Represents an image (external URI or bufferView). Stores decoded pixel data unless as_is is true, along with metadata and extras/extensions.
References an image (source) with an optional sampler. Holds extras/extensions.
Texture reference with texture index and optional texCoord set and metadata. Used in materials.
Material normal map reference including scale factor and texCoord set.
Material occlusion texture reference with strength and texCoord set.
Core PBR metallic-roughness material model: base color factor/texture, metallic and roughness factors/textures, plus extras/extensions.
glTF material with PBR fields, emissive and alpha settings, optional LOD extension, and legacy parameter maps. Includes extras/extensions.
Sliced view into a Buffer: offset, length, optional stride and target. May be marked dracoDecoded when generated from KHR_draco decoding.
Describes typed view of buffer data with component type, count, value type (SCALAR/VEC/MAT), normalization, min/max, and optional sparse storage info.
Perspective camera parameters (yfov, znear required; zfar/aspect optional).
Orthographic camera parameters (xmag, ymag, znear, zfar).
Camera object of type "perspective" or "orthographic" with parameters and metadata.
A drawable primitive: attribute accessor indices, optional index accessor, material, drawing mode, morph targets, and extensions/extras. May carry KHR_draco_mesh_compression extension data.
Collection of primitives with optional initial morph target weights and metadata.
Scene graph node referencing mesh, camera, skin, and extension-based light/emitter; holds transform (TRS or matrix), children, weights, LODs, and extras/extensions.
Raw binary data store for buffer views. May be embedded (data URI) or external via URI.
Top-level asset metadata (version, generator, copyright) with extras/extensions.
Root scene referencing node indices and optional global audio emitters (KHR_audio).
Spot light cone parameters for KHR_lights_punctual.
KHR_lights_punctual light definition (directional/point/spot). Holds color, intensity, optional range and spot sub-struct.
KHR_audio positional parameters (cones, distances, rolloff). Used when AudioEmitter type is positional.
KHR_audio emitter definition (global or positional) with playback flags, gain, source index and optional positional parameters.
KHR_audio audio source, either external URI or bufferView with mimeType.
Top-level in-memory glTF representation aggregating all entities (buffers, images, meshes, nodes, scenes, materials, etc.) with asset metadata and extension lists.

objects.definition:
enum SectionCheck {
  NO_REQUIRE = 0x00,
  REQUIRE_VERSION = 0x01,
  REQUIRE_SCENE = 0x02,
  REQUIRE_SCENES = 0x04,
  REQUIRE_NODES = 0x08,
  REQUIRE_ACCESSORS = 0x10,
  REQUIRE_BUFFERS = 0x20,
  REQUIRE_BUFFER_VIEWS = 0x40,
  REQUIRE_ALL = 0x7f
};
objects.description: Bitmask controlling required sections when loading glTF via TinyGLTF APIs.
Callback type for encoding URIs when writing files. Allows customizing how buffer/image URIs are produced.
Callback type for decoding URIs to paths when reading/writing.
Holds URI encode/decode callbacks and user data for TinyGLTF I/O.

objects.definition:
using FileExistsFunction = std::function<bool(
    const std::string & /* abs_filename */, void * /* user_data */)>;
objects.description: Filesystem callback for existence check.

objects.definition:
using ExpandFilePathFunction =
    std::function<std::string(const std::string &, void *)>;
objects.description: Filesystem callback for expanding a path string to absolute or environment-expanded path.

objects.definition:
using ReadWholeFileFunction = std::function<bool(
    std::vector<unsigned char> *, std::string *, const std::string &, void *)>;
objects.description: Filesystem callback to read entire file into memory.
Filesystem callback to write entire buffer to a file.
Filesystem callback to get file size in bytes.
Bundle of filesystem callbacks and user data used by TinyGLTF for I/O.
User-supplied or default callback to decode raw bytes to Image pixels (or leave as-is).
Callback to serialize an Image to file or data URI and return the URI used in glTF.
The main glTF loader/serializer context. Provides load/save APIs, options, and user-extensible callbacks for filesystem, URI, and image processing.

functions.name: tinygltf::GetComponentSizeInBytes
functions.description: Returns the size in bytes of a glTF component type (e.g., BYTE, UNSIGNED_SHORT, FLOAT). Returns -1 for unknown types.
requirements: componentType must be one of TINYGLTF_COMPONENT_TYPE_* constants (BYTE, UNSIGNED_BYTE, SHORT, UNSIGNED_SHORT, INT, UNSIGNED_INT, FLOAT, DOUBLE).
If an unknown value is provided, the function returns -1 and the caller should treat it as an error.

functions.name: tinygltf::GetNumComponentsInType
functions.description: Returns the number of scalar components for a glTF accessor type (e.g., SCALAR=1, VEC3=3, MAT4=16). Returns -1 for unknown types.
requirements: ty must be one of TINYGLTF_TYPE_* constants (SCALAR, VEC2, VEC3, VEC4, MAT2, MAT3, MAT4).
If an unknown value is provided, the function returns -1 and the caller should treat it as an error.

functions.name: tinygltf::IsDataURI
functions.description: Checks if the given string is a supported data URI containing base64-encoded content (e.g., images, buffer).
requirements: in must be a URI string; no decoding is performed here.
Returns true only for known prefixes such as data:*;base64, including image/jpeg, image/png, image/bmp, image/gif, text/plain, application/octet-stream, application/gltf-buffer.

functions.name: tinygltf::DecodeDataURI
functions.signature: bool tinygltf::DecodeDataURI(std::vector<unsigned char> *out, std::string &mime_type, const std::string &in, size_t reqBytes, bool checkSize)
functions.description: Decodes a base64 data URI into raw bytes and outputs the mime type when recognized. Optionally checks that the decoded size matches reqBytes.
requirements: out must be non-null and will be resized to decoded size (or reqBytes when checkSize is true).
in must be a base64 data URI with a supported prefix.
If checkSize is true, the decoded size must equal reqBytes; otherwise the function returns false.
On success, mime_type is set for known image/text prefixes; otherwise it may remain default/empty.
Returns false when the data URI is not recognized or the payload is empty.

functions.name: tinygltf::Value::Type
functions.description: Returns the internal type tag of the JSON-like Value (NULL_TYPE, REAL_TYPE, INT_TYPE, BOOL_TYPE, STRING_TYPE, ARRAY_TYPE, BINARY_TYPE, OBJECT_TYPE).
requirements: Callable on any Value instance.
Returned char encodes the enum Type; callers should compare against tinygltf::Type constants.

functions.name: tinygltf::Value::IsBool
functions.description: Returns true if the Value holds a boolean.
requirements: None.

functions.name: tinygltf::Value::IsInt
functions.description: Returns true if the Value holds an integer.
requirements: None.

functions.name: tinygltf::Value::IsNumber
functions.description: Returns true if the Value holds a numeric type (integer or real).
requirements: None.

functions.name: tinygltf::Value::IsReal
functions.description: Returns true if the Value holds a real (double) number.
requirements: None.

functions.name: tinygltf::Value::IsString
functions.description: Returns true if the Value holds a string.
requirements: None.

functions.name: tinygltf::Value::IsBinary
functions.description: Returns true if the Value holds binary data.
requirements: None.

functions.name: tinygltf::Value::IsArray
functions.description: Returns true if the Value holds an array.
requirements: None.

functions.name: tinygltf::Value::IsObject
functions.description: Returns true if the Value holds an object (string->Value map).
requirements: None.

functions.name: tinygltf::Value::GetNumberAsDouble
functions.description: Returns the number value as double. If the stored type is INT, it is promoted to double; otherwise returns the REAL value.
requirements: Value must be a number (IsNumber() true) for meaningful results; otherwise returns 0.0 based on initialization.

functions.name: tinygltf::Value::GetNumberAsInt
functions.description: Returns the number value as int. If the stored type is REAL, it is truncated to int; otherwise returns the INT value.
requirements: Value should be numeric; for REAL types fractional part is truncated.

functions.name: tinygltf::Value::Get
functions.description: Typed accessor to the underlying storage. Specializations exist for bool, double, int, std::string, std::vector<unsigned char>, Value::Array, and Value::Object.
requirements: T must be one of the supported specializations; otherwise linkage will fail.
Caller must ensure the underlying type matches T; no runtime checks are performed.

functions.name: tinygltf::Value::Get
functions.description: Mutable typed accessor to the underlying storage. Specializations exist for bool, double, int, std::string, std::vector<unsigned char>, Value::Array, and Value::Object.
requirements: T must be one of the supported specializations; otherwise linkage will fail.
Caller must ensure the underlying type matches T; no runtime checks are performed before returning a reference.

functions.name: tinygltf::Value::Get
functions.description: Array element lookup by index. Returns a reference to the element if idx is in range; otherwise returns a reference to a static null Value.
requirements: Value must be an array (asserts in debug builds).
idx should be less than ArrayLen() to avoid getting the static null Value.

functions.name: tinygltf::Value::Get
functions.description: Object member lookup by key. Returns a reference to the member if it exists; otherwise returns a reference to a static null Value.
requirements: Value must be an object (asserts in debug builds).
key should be present to avoid getting the static null Value.

functions.name: tinygltf::Value::Get
functions.description: Returns a const reference to the internal boolean stored in this tinygltf::Value. Use when the Value represents a JSON boolean. Only explicit specializations are defined; this overload is one of them.
requirements: Caller must ensure the Value currently holds a boolean (Value::IsBool() == true) before calling.
The returned reference remains valid only as long as the Value object is alive and its type/contents are not changed.

functions.name: tinygltf::Value::Get
functions.description: Returns a mutable reference to the internal boolean stored in this tinygltf::Value. Allows in-place modification of the stored boolean. Only explicit specializations are defined; this overload is one of them.
requirements: Caller must ensure the Value currently holds a boolean (Value::IsBool() == true) before calling.
Modifying the returned reference changes the Value’s stored boolean in place; the Value’s type must remain BOOL_TYPE.
The returned reference remains valid only as long as the Value object is alive and its type/contents are not changed.

functions.name: tinygltf::Value::Get
functions.description: Returns a const reference to the internal std::string stored in this tinygltf::Value. Use when the Value represents a JSON string. Only explicit specializations are defined; this overload is one of them.
requirements: Caller must ensure the Value currently holds a string (Value::IsString() == true) before calling.
The returned reference remains valid only as long as the Value object is alive and its type/contents are not changed.

functions.name: tinygltf::Value::Get
functions.description: Returns a mutable reference to the internal std::string stored in this tinygltf::Value. Allows in-place modification of the stored string. Only explicit specializations are defined; this overload is one of them.
requirements: Caller must ensure the Value currently holds a string (Value::IsString() == true) before calling.
Modifying the returned reference changes the Value’s stored string in place; the Value’s type must remain STRING_TYPE.
The returned reference remains valid only as long as the Value object is alive and its type/contents are not changed.

functions.name: tinygltf::Value::ArrayLen
functions.description: Returns the number of elements if the Value is an array; otherwise 0.
requirements: None, but returns 0 when not an array.

functions.name: tinygltf::Value::Has
functions.description: Returns true if the object Value contains the given key.
requirements: Value must be an object for meaningful results; otherwise returns false.

functions.name: tinygltf::Value::Keys
functions.description: Returns a vector of keys if the Value is an object; otherwise an empty vector.
requirements: Value should be an object to get keys.

functions.name: tinygltf::Value::Size
functions.description: Returns array length if array, otherwise number of keys if object; 0 for other types.
requirements: None.

functions.name: tinygltf::Value::operator==
functions.description: Deep equality comparison between two Value instances (recursively compares arrays/objects, with epsilon comparison for doubles).
requirements: Binary equality uses TINYGLTF_DOUBLE_EQUAL for doubles; make sure your equality expectations account for epsilon.

functions.name: tinygltf::Parameter::TextureIndex
functions.description: Returns the texture index from a material texture-parameter-like JSON object, using json_double_value["index"], or -1 if absent.
requirements: Meaningful only when the Parameter represents a texture map.
Returns -1 when index is not present.

functions.name: tinygltf::Parameter::TextureTexCoord
functions.description: Returns the TEXCOORD set index from json_double_value["texCoord"], or 0 when not present (per glTF spec default).
requirements: Meaningful only when Parameter represents a texture map.

functions.name: tinygltf::Parameter::TextureScale
functions.description: Returns the normal map scale from json_double_value["scale"], or 1.0 when absent (per glTF spec default).
requirements: Meaningful only for normal texture maps.

functions.name: tinygltf::Parameter::TextureStrength
functions.description: Returns the occlusion strength from json_double_value["strength"], or 1.0 when absent (per glTF spec default).
requirements: Meaningful only for occlusion texture maps.

functions.name: tinygltf::Parameter::Factor
functions.description: Returns the numeric factor (e.g., roughness/metallic) stored in number_value.
requirements: Only meaningful when the Parameter represents a numeric factor.

functions.name: tinygltf::Parameter::ColorFactor
functions.description: Returns the color factor as an array of 4 doubles from number_array, using 1.0 as default alpha if array length is 3.
requirements: number_array must contain at least 3 elements; if fewer, behavior follows direct access and may be undefined.
Intended for color-like parameters.

functions.name: tinygltf::Parameter::operator==
functions.description: Equality comparison for legacy Parameter (compares booleans, numbers, number arrays with epsilon, strings, and JSON-number map).
requirements: Uses epsilon comparison for doubles; exact key set equality for json_double_value.

functions.name: tinygltf::AnimationChannel::operator==
functions.description: Compares animation channels by sampler, target node/path, extras and extensions.
requirements: None.

functions.name: tinygltf::AnimationSampler::operator==
functions.description: Compares animation samplers by input/output indices, interpolation, extras and extensions.
requirements: None.

functions.name: tinygltf::Animation::operator==
functions.description: Compares animations by channels, samplers, name, extras and extensions.
requirements: None.

functions.name: tinygltf::Skin::operator==
functions.description: Compares skins by joints, inverse bind matrices index, skeleton, name, extras and extensions.
requirements: None.

functions.name: tinygltf::Sampler::operator==
functions.description: Compares samplers by filter/wrap settings, name, extras and extensions.
requirements: None.

functions.name: tinygltf::Image::operator==
functions.description: Compares images by pixel metadata, bufferView, mimeType, name, uri, extras and extensions, and raw data.
requirements: None.

functions.name: tinygltf::Texture::operator==
functions.description: Compares textures by sampler, source, name, extras and extensions.
requirements: None.

functions.name: tinygltf::TextureInfo::operator==
functions.description: Compares texture infos by index, texCoord, extras and extensions.
requirements: None.

functions.name: tinygltf::NormalTextureInfo::operator==
functions.description: Compares normal texture infos by index, texCoord, scale (epsilon), extras and extensions.
requirements: None.

functions.name: tinygltf::OcclusionTextureInfo::operator==
functions.description: Compares occlusion texture infos by index, texCoord, strength (epsilon), extras and extensions.
requirements: None.

functions.name: tinygltf::PbrMetallicRoughness::operator==
functions.description: Compares PBR properties (baseColorFactor, metallicFactor, roughnessFactor), textures, extras and extensions.
requirements: Uses epsilon for double comparisons.

functions.name: tinygltf::BufferView::operator==
functions.description: Compares buffer views by buffer, offsets/length/stride, target, name, flags, extras and extensions.
requirements: None.

functions.name: tinygltf::Accessor::ByteStride
functions.description: Computes effective byte stride for an accessor given its bufferView. Returns the bufferView's byteStride if set (after validation) or the tightly packed stride (component size × component count). Returns -1 on invalid configuration.
requirements: accessor.componentType must be valid (GetComponentSizeInBytes > 0).
accessor.type must be valid (GetNumComponentsInType > 0).
If bufferViewObject.byteStride != 0, it must be a multiple of the component size; otherwise returns -1.

functions.name: tinygltf::Accessor::operator==
functions.description: Compares accessors by bufferView, offset, componentType, count, type, min/max values (epsilon), name, normalized, extras and extensions.
requirements: None.

functions.name: tinygltf::PerspectiveCamera::operator==
functions.description: Compares perspective cameras by aspectRatio, yfov, znear, zfar (epsilon), extras and extensions.
requirements: None.

functions.name: tinygltf::OrthographicCamera::operator==
functions.description: Compares orthographic cameras by xmag, ymag, znear, zfar (epsilon), extras and extensions.
requirements: None.

functions.name: tinygltf::Camera::operator==
functions.description: Compares cameras by type, name, and contained perspective/orthographic data, extras and extensions.
requirements: None.

functions.name: tinygltf::Primitive::operator==
functions.description: Compares mesh primitives by attributes, indices, material, mode, targets, extras and extensions.
requirements: None.

functions.name: tinygltf::Mesh::operator==
functions.description: Compares meshes by primitives, weights (epsilon), name, extras and extensions.
requirements: None.

functions.name: tinygltf::Node::operator==
functions.description: Compares nodes by camera, mesh, skin, light/emitter, transforms (epsilon), children, weights, name, extras and extensions.
requirements: None.

functions.name: tinygltf::Buffer::operator==
functions.description: Compares buffers by data, name, uri, extras and extensions.
requirements: None.

functions.name: tinygltf::Asset::operator==
functions.description: Compares assets by version, minVersion, generator, copyright, extras and extensions.
requirements: None.

functions.name: tinygltf::Scene::operator==
functions.description: Compares scenes by name, node list, extras and extensions.
requirements: None.

functions.name: tinygltf::SpotLight::operator==
functions.description: Compares spot light parameters (inner/outer cone angles with epsilon), extras and extensions.
requirements: None.

functions.name: tinygltf::Light::operator==
functions.description: Compares lights by color (epsilon), name, type; range/intensity comparisons as doubles, extras and extensions.
requirements: None.

functions.name: tinygltf::PositionalEmitter::operator==
functions.description: Compares positional emitters by cone angles/gain, distances, rolloff (epsilon), extras and extensions.
requirements: None.

functions.name: tinygltf::AudioEmitter::operator==
functions.description: Compares audio emitters by name, gain (epsilon), loop/playing flags, type, distanceModel, source, extras and extensions.
requirements: None.

functions.name: tinygltf::AudioSource::operator==
functions.description: Compares audio sources by name and uri (and implicitly any other serialized fields).
requirements: None.

functions.name: tinygltf::Model::operator==
functions.description: Deep equality comparison of all top-level model arrays/fields, extras and extensions.
requirements: Potentially expensive; compares large vectors.

functions.name: tinygltf::URIDecode
functions.description: Decodes percent-encoded characters and plus signs in a URI into a decoded path string. Default implementation uses dlib-style urldecode logic.
requirements: out_uri must be non-null; user_data is unused.
Always returns true in the default implementation.

functions.name: tinygltf::FileExists
functions.description: Default filesystem callback to check for file existence (and not a directory). Windows/Android/POSIX variants are handled.
requirements: abs_filename must be an absolute or valid path; behavior depends on platform APIs.
Returns false for directories or when the file cannot be opened for reading.

functions.name: tinygltf::ExpandFilePath
functions.description: Default filesystem callback to expand file paths. Currently returns the input path unchanged for security and spec reasons.
requirements: No expansion is performed; callers should supply already-expanded absolute paths as needed.

functions.name: tinygltf::ReadWholeFile
functions.signature: bool tinygltf::ReadWholeFile(std::vector<unsigned char> *out, std::string *err, const std::string &filepath, void *)
functions.description: Reads an entire file into memory. Populates out with the contents on success, otherwise writes an error message to err and returns false.
requirements: out must be non-null.
err may be non-null to capture detailed errors.
filepath must refer to a regular file; directories or empty files cause failure.
On POSIX/Windows, file is opened in binary mode.

functions.name: tinygltf::WriteWholeFile
functions.signature: bool tinygltf::WriteWholeFile(std::string *err, const std::string &filepath, const std::vector<unsigned char> &contents, void *)
functions.description: Writes the provided contents to a file, truncating/creating it. Returns true on success; otherwise writes an error string to err.
requirements: err may be non-null to capture errors.
filepath must be writable; function opens the file in binary mode.
On failure, no partial write guarantee is provided by the API.

functions.name: tinygltf::GetFileSizeInBytes
functions.signature: bool tinygltf::GetFileSizeInBytes(size_t *filesize_out, std::string *err, const std::string &filepath, void *userdata)
functions.description: Gets the size of a file in bytes. Returns true on success and writes the size to filesize_out. Performs validation to reject directories, empty files, or invalid sizes.
requirements: filesize_out must be non-null.
err may be non-null to capture errors.
filepath must refer to a non-empty regular file; directories and empty files are reported as errors.

functions.name: tinygltf::LoadImageData
functions.signature: bool tinygltf::LoadImageData(Image *image, const int image_idx, std::string *err, std::string *warn, int req_width, int req_height, const unsigned char *bytes, int size, void *user_data)
functions.description: Default image loading callback using stb_image. Decodes image header/data unless configured to keep data as-is. On success fills Image fields and pixel data.
requirements: image must be non-null; bytes must point to image data with given size.
If user_data points to LoadImageDataOption, its flags control channel preservation and as-is behavior.
If option.as_is is true, the raw bytes are copied without decoding, and width/height/component/bits/pixel_type are set to invalid (-1).
If decoding, req_width/req_height > 0 enforce exact matches; mismatches cause failure.
On failure, errors go to err; non-critical issues may go to warn.

functions.name: tinygltf::WriteImageData
functions.signature: bool tinygltf::WriteImageData(const std::string *basepath, const std::string *filename, const Image *image, bool embedImages, const FsCallbacks *fs_cb, const URICallbacks *uri_cb, std::string *out_uri, void *user_pointer)
functions.description: Default image writing callback using stb_image_write. Writes Image either embedded as a data URI (when embedImages) or to disk, setting out_uri appropriately.
requirements: image must be non-null; out_uri must be non-null.
If image->as_is is true and ext is a supported format (png/jpg/bmp), the encoded data is used as-is; otherwise image->bits/pixel_type/component must be compatible with the chosen format.
When writing to disk, fs_cb->WriteWholeFile must be provided; on success out_uri is the (optionally encoded) filename.
Returns false for unsupported pixel formats or write failures.

functions.name: tinygltf::TinyGLTF::LoadASCIIFromFile
functions.signature: bool tinygltf::TinyGLTF::LoadASCIIFromFile(tinygltf::Model *model, std::string *err, std::string *warn, const std::string &filename, unsigned int check_sections = REQUIRE_VERSION)
functions.description: Loads a glTF (JSON/ASCII) file from disk, resolving external resources using internal filesystem callbacks. On success fills the provided Model.
requirements: model must be non-null.
err/warn may be non-null to receive diagnostics.
filename must be readable; fs callbacks must be set (default are provided).
check_sections bitmask can require certain top-level arrays/objects; missing required sections cause failure.
On failure, returns false and writes an error string.

functions.name: tinygltf::TinyGLTF::LoadASCIIFromString
functions.signature: bool tinygltf::TinyGLTF::LoadASCIIFromString(tinygltf::Model *model, std::string *err, std::string *warn, const char *str, const unsigned int length, const std::string &base_dir, unsigned int check_sections = REQUIRE_VERSION)
functions.description: Parses a glTF (JSON/ASCII) document from memory and loads external resources from base_dir. On success populates Model.
requirements: model must be non-null; str must point to JSON text of given length (length >= 4).
base_dir should be an expanded path; used to resolve external URIs.
err/warn may be non-null; check_sections applies as in file load.
Returns false on parse/validation errors.

functions.name: tinygltf::TinyGLTF::LoadBinaryFromFile
functions.signature: bool tinygltf::TinyGLTF::LoadBinaryFromFile(tinygltf::Model *model, std::string *err, std::string *warn, const std::string &filename, unsigned int check_sections = REQUIRE_VERSION)
functions.description: Loads a binary glTF (.glb) file from disk, parses its JSON chunk and (optional) BIN chunk, and resolves external resources. On success fills Model.
requirements: model must be non-null; filename must be readable.
GLB must have valid header, JSON chunk, and optional BIN chunk according to spec; otherwise fails.
err/warn may be non-null for diagnostics.
check_sections applies as in ASCII load.

functions.name: tinygltf::TinyGLTF::LoadBinaryFromMemory
functions.signature: bool tinygltf::TinyGLTF::LoadBinaryFromMemory(tinygltf::Model *model, std::string *err, std::string *warn, const unsigned char *bytes, const unsigned int length, const std::string &base_dir = "", unsigned int check_sections = REQUIRE_VERSION)
functions.description: Loads a binary glTF (.glb) document from memory, validates header/chunks, parses JSON, and sets up access to the BIN chunk for subsequent resource parsing. On success fills Model.
requirements: model must be non-null; bytes must point to a buffer of size length (>= 20).
bytes[0..3] must be 'glTF'; GLB fields (version/length/chunks) must be consistent and aligned to 4-byte boundaries (strict mode).
base_dir used to resolve external URIs if present.
err/warn may be non-null; returns false on validation errors.

functions.name: tinygltf::TinyGLTF::WriteGltfSceneToStream
functions.signature: bool tinygltf::TinyGLTF::WriteGltfSceneToStream(const tinygltf::Model *model, std::ostream &stream, bool prettyPrint, bool writeBinary)
functions.description: Serializes a Model to a stream as JSON (.gltf) or GLB (.glb) depending on writeBinary. Buffers and images are embedded when writing to a stream.
requirements: model must be non-null; stream must be open for writing.
If writeBinary is true, only the first buffer without a URI is placed in the GLB BIN chunk; others are embedded as data URIs.
Returns false if serialization or embedded image update fails.

functions.name: tinygltf::TinyGLTF::WriteGltfSceneToFile
functions.signature: bool tinygltf::TinyGLTF::WriteGltfSceneToFile(const tinygltf::Model *model, const std::string &filename, bool embedImages, bool embedBuffers, bool prettyPrint, bool writeBinary)
functions.description: Serializes a Model to a file as JSON (.gltf) or GLB (.glb). Can embed images/buffers as data URIs or write them out as separate files; sets URIs accordingly.
requirements: model must be non-null; filename path must be writable.
When not embedding, default FS callbacks are used to write external resources; failures will cause the function to return false.
If writeBinary is true, the first buffer without a URI is stored in the GLB BIN chunk.

functions.name: tinygltf::TinyGLTF::SetParseStrictness
functions.description: Sets the parser strictness (Strict or Permissive). Affects validation and warnings during load.
requirements: Call before load to affect subsequent parsing behavior.

functions.name: tinygltf::TinyGLTF::SetImageLoader
functions.description: Registers a custom image loading callback. Passing nullptr resets to the default (equivalent to RemoveImageLoader).
requirements: If LoadImageData is nullptr, the loader is reset to the default and user_data is ignored.
Custom callback will be invoked for all image loads; ensure it follows the LoadImageDataFunction contract.

functions.name: tinygltf::TinyGLTF::RemoveImageLoader
functions.description: Unsets the custom image loader and restores the default loader (if available).
requirements: None.

functions.name: tinygltf::TinyGLTF::SetImageWriter
functions.description: Registers a custom image writer callback for serialization.
requirements: WriteImageData may be nullptr only if you do not serialize images; otherwise provide a valid function.
user_data is passed through to the callback.

functions.name: tinygltf::TinyGLTF::SetURICallbacks
functions.description: Sets custom URI encode/decode callbacks and user data. Decode callback is required; encode is optional.
requirements: callbacks.decode must be non-null; otherwise returns false and optionally sets err.
On success, callbacks are stored internally and used for all subsequent URI processing.

functions.name: tinygltf::TinyGLTF::SetFsCallbacks
functions.description: Sets custom filesystem callbacks and user data. All callbacks are required.
requirements: callbacks.FileExists, ExpandFilePath, ReadWholeFile, WriteWholeFile, and GetFileSizeInBytes must be non-null; otherwise returns false and optionally sets err.
On success, the callbacks are used for subsequent IO.

functions.name: tinygltf::TinyGLTF::SetSerializeDefaultValues
functions.description: Controls whether default values are explicitly serialized in output (false by default).
requirements: Affects subsequent serialization; does not retroactively change existing JSON.

functions.name: tinygltf::TinyGLTF::GetSerializeDefaultValues
functions.description: Returns whether default values are force-serialized.
requirements: None.

functions.name: tinygltf::TinyGLTF::SetStoreOriginalJSONForExtrasAndExtensions
functions.description: Controls whether original JSON strings for extras and extensions are stored for round-tripping/custom parsing.
requirements: Affects subsequent parses/serializations.

functions.name: tinygltf::TinyGLTF::GetStoreOriginalJSONForExtrasAndExtensions
functions.description: Returns whether original JSON strings for extras/extensions are stored.
requirements: None.

functions.name: tinygltf::TinyGLTF::SetPreserveImageChannels
functions.description: Controls whether the loader preserves original image channel counts instead of expanding to RGBA (default false).
requirements: Only affects the default image loader path (not custom callbacks).

functions.name: tinygltf::TinyGLTF::GetPreserveImageChannels
functions.description: Returns the current preserve-image-channels setting.
requirements: None.

functions.name: tinygltf::TinyGLTF::SetImagesAsIs
functions.description: Controls whether image data is left as-is (encoded) instead of being decoded during load (default false).
requirements: Only affects the default image loader path (not custom callbacks).

functions.name: tinygltf::TinyGLTF::GetImagesAsIs
functions.description: Returns the current images-as-is setting.
requirements: None.

functions.name: tinygltf::TinyGLTF::SetMaxExternalFileSize
functions.description: Sets the maximum allowed external file size in bytes for built-in filesystem reads (default ~2GB).
requirements: Affects only built-in FS functions; custom FS callbacks may ignore this.

functions.name: tinygltf::TinyGLTF::GetMaxExternalFileSize
functions.description: Returns the current maximum allowed external file size in bytes used by the built-in FS.
requirements: None.

data_types.description: A data URI string using the data: scheme with a supported media type and a base64-encoded payload. Examples: data:image/png;base64,..., data:application/octet-stream;base64,..., data:text/plain;base64,..., data:application/gltf-buffer;base64,... The prefix must indicate base64 and the payload is base64 text representing arbitrary bytes.
An unconstrained string of bytes returned by FUZZ_PARAM_STR, used wherever a generic std::string is accepted (names, URIs, JSON fragments, etc.). No specific format is required.

generators.generator:
import base64
import random
import string
from typing import List

def _rand_str(rng: random.Random, min_len: int, max_len: int) -> str:
    n = rng.randint(min_len, max_len)
    # Mix URL-friendly and general ASCII to explore URI cases
    alphabet = string.ascii_letters + string.digits + "-_./:+%?&= "
    return "".join(rng.choice(alphabet) for _ in range(n))

def _b64_data_uri(rng: random.Random, payload: bytes) -> bytes:
    # Choose a supported prefix matching tinygltf::IsDataURI/DecodeDataURI
    prefixes = [
        b"data:application/octet-stream;base64,",
        b"data:image/png;base64,",
        b"data:text/plain;base64,",
        b"data:application/gltf-buffer;base64,",
    ]
    prefix = rng.choice(prefixes)
    b64 = base64.b64encode(payload)
    return prefix + b64

def _interesting_payloads(rng: random.Random) -> List[bytes]:
    # Create a set of small, valid payloads to exercise DecodeDataURI success paths
    payloads: List[bytes] = []
    # Single-byte patterns used in stubs (ensure success)
    payloads.append(b"\x00")
    payloads.append(b"\x01")
    # Small structured bytes
    payloads.append(b"GLTF")
    payloads.append(b"PNG\r\n\x1a\n")
    # Repeated patterns of varying lengths (1..16)
    for rep in range(1, 5):
        payloads.append(bytes([rep]) * rng.randint(2, 16))
    # Random ASCII snippet (1..64)
    s = _rand_str(rng, 1, 64).encode("utf-8", errors="ignore")
    if not s:
        s = b"a"
    payloads.append(s)
    return payloads

def _build_audio_source_json(rng: random.Random) -> bytes:
    # Build a tiny JSON representing an AudioSource-like object from the stub expectations
    # Two modes: URI-based (with data URI) or bufferView-based (with mimeType)
    name = _rand_str(rng, 0, 16)
    if rng.random() < 0.5:
        # URI-based
        # Use a one-byte payload to mirror the stub's validation path
        uri = _b64_data_uri(rng, b"\x00").decode("ascii")
        obj = {
            "name": name,
            "uri": uri,
            "bufferView": -1,
            "mimeType": ""
        }
    else:
        # bufferView-based
        mime = rng.choice(["audio/ogg", "audio/wav"])
        obj = {
            "name": name,
            "bufferView": rng.randrange(0, 8),
            "mimeType": mime
        }
    # Minimal, compact JSON without external dependencies
    import json
    return json.dumps(obj, separators=(",", ":")).encode("utf-8")

def _build_buffer_json(rng: random.Random) -> bytes:
    # Build a JSON representing a Buffer with non-empty data and optional data URI
    name = _rand_str(rng, 0, 16)
    # Generate up to 1024 bytes; make it small to keep overall under 4096
    n = rng.randint(8, 64)
    s = _rand_str(rng, n, n).encode("utf-8", errors="ignore") or b"A" * n
    data_hex = s.hex()
    if rng.random() < 0.5:
        uri = _b64_data_uri(rng, b"\x00").decode("ascii")
    else:
        uri = ""
    obj = {
        "name": name,
        "uri": uri,
        "data": data_hex  # just to carry something; library stub only checks non-empty data vector created elsewhere
    }
    import json
    return json.dumps(obj, separators=(",", ":")).encode("utf-8")

def _build_data_uri_section(rng: random.Random) -> bytes:
    # Mix of valid data URIs and arbitrary strings for IsDataURI fuzz stub
    out: List[bytes] = []
    # Guaranteed valid URIs using small payloads
    for p in _interesting_payloads(rng):
        out.append(_b64_data_uri(rng, p))
    # Some arbitrary strings that are not data URIs
    for _ in range(3):
        out.append(_rand_str(rng, 5, 24).encode("utf-8", errors="ignore"))
    # Join with newlines so FUZZ_PARAM_STR could consume slices sensibly
    return b"\n".join(out)

def _build_decode_data_uri_primary(rng: random.Random) -> bytes:
    # Provide one primary valid data URI that DecodeDataURI can succeed on regardless of checkSize
    # Keep payload size small (1..32)
    size = rng.randint(1, 32)
    payload = bytes(rng.getrandbits(8) for _ in range(size))
    return _b64_data_uri(rng, payload)

def generate(seed: int) -> bytes:
    rng = random.Random(seed)

    # Assemble a compact buffer with multiple sections separated by newlines:
    # 1) Several valid/invalid strings for IsDataURI
    # 2) One valid data URI for DecodeDataURI success path
    # 3) A compact JSON for AudioSource configuration
    # 4) A compact JSON for Buffer configuration
    parts: List[bytes] = []

    parts.append(_build_data_uri_section(rng))
    parts.append(b"\n\n")
    parts.append(_build_decode_data_uri_primary(rng))
    parts.append(b"\n\n")
    parts.append(_build_audio_source_json(rng))
    parts.append(b"\n\n")
    parts.append(_build_buffer_json(rng))

    blob = b"".join(parts)
    # Ensure size limit
    if len(blob) > 4096:
        blob = blob[:4096]
    return blob

import random
import base64
from typing import List

# Generator for interesting arbitrary strings used across tinygltf fuzz stubs.
# It focuses on valid, meaningful values: data URIs for images/buffers, file-like
# names/paths, JSON-like fragments, identifiers, and short textual content.

_MAX_SIZE = 4096

_image_png_min = (
    b"\x89PNG\r\n\x1a\n"  # signature
    b"\x00\x00\x00\rIHDR"  # IHDR len+type
    b"\x00\x00\x00\x01\x00\x00\x00\x01"  # 1x1
    b"\x08\x06\x00\x00\x00"  # 8-bit RGBA
    b"\x1f\x15\xc4\x89"  # CRC (placeholder for this minimal sample)
    b"\x00\x00\x00\x0AIDAT"  # small IDAT chunk
    b"\x78\x9c\x63\x60\x00\x00\x00\x02\x00\x01"  # zlib minimal
    b"\x0d\x0a\x2d\xb4"  # CRC
    b"\x00\x00\x00\x00IEND\xaeB`\x82"  # IEND
)

# Simple 1-byte payload for compact data URIs
_octet_1 = b"\x00"

_data_uri_templates = [
    # Known supported data URI prefixes for IsDataURI/DecodeDataURI
    ("data:image/png;base64,", _image_png_min),
    ("data:image/jpeg;base64,", b"/9j/4AAQSkZJRgABAQAAAQABAAD/"),
    ("data:image/bmp;base64,", b"Qk0AAAAAAAAAAAAA"),
    ("data:image/gif;base64,", b"R0lGODlhAQABAIAAAAUEBA=="),
    ("data:text/plain;base64,", b"Hello, tinygltf!\n"),
    ("data:application/octet-stream;base64,", _octet_1),
    ("data:application/gltf-buffer;base64,", b"ABCD"),
]

_common_names = [
    "node", "mesh", "scene", "camera", "material", "texture", "image",
    "emitter", "source", "sampler", "accessor", "bufferview", "buffer",
]

_common_exts = [".gltf", ".glb", ".bin", ".png", ".jpg", ".jpeg", ".bmp", ".gif", ".wav", ".ogg"]

_uri_schemes = [
    "file:", "http://example.com/", "https://example.com/", "./", "../", ""  # plain relative
]

_json_snippets = [
    '{"asset":{"version":"2.0"}}',
    '{"name":"foo","extras":true}',
    '{"extensions":{}}',
    '{"buffers":[{"byteLength":4}]}',
]

_ascii = "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyzABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ0123456789_-"


def _rand_ident(r: random.Random, min_len=3, max_len=12) -> str:
    n = r.randint(min_len, max_len)
    return "".join(r.choice(_ascii) for _ in range(n))


def _make_filename(r: random.Random) -> str:
    name = r.choice(_common_names) + "_" + _rand_ident(r)
    ext = r.choice(_common_exts)
    return name + ext


def _make_pathlike(r: random.Random) -> str:
    scheme = r.choice(_uri_schemes)
    parts = [scheme]
    depth = r.randint(0, 3)
    for _ in range(depth):
        parts.append(_rand_ident(r))
        parts.append("/")
    parts.append(_make_filename(r))
    return "".join(parts)


def _make_data_uri(r: random.Random) -> str:
    prefix, payload = r.choice(_data_uri_templates)
    # optionally vary payload size with valid base64
    if r.random() < 0.5:
        # repeat or slice payload
        base = payload
        rep = r.randint(1, 3)
        data = (base * rep)[: min(len(base) * rep, 64)]
    else:
        # small arbitrary bytes
        n = r.randint(1, 32)
        data = bytes(r.getrandbits(8) for _ in range(n))
    b64 = base64.b64encode(data).decode("ascii")
    return prefix + b64


def _make_plain_text(r: random.Random) -> str:
    # Short strings suitable for names or values
    choices = [
        _rand_ident(r, 1, 16),
        "perspective", "orthographic", "directional", "point", "spot",
        "LINEAR", "STEP", "CUBICSPLINE",
        "OPAQUE", "MASK", "BLEND",
    ]
    s = r.choice(choices)
    if r.random() < 0.4:
        s += "_" + _rand_ident(r, 1, 6)
    return s


def _make_uri_like(r: random.Random) -> str:
    # Either data URI or path-like/percent-encoded
    if r.random() < 0.6:
        return _make_data_uri(r)
    s = _make_pathlike(r)
    # sometimes add simple percent-encoding
    if r.random() < 0.5:
        s = s.replace(" ", "%20")
    return s


def _compose_mixed(r: random.Random, budget: int) -> str:
    # Build a mixed string combining JSON, URIs, and names but within size budget
    parts: List[str] = []
    total = 0
    while budget > 0 and len(parts) < 6:
        choice = r.random()
        if choice < 0.3:
            frag = r.choice(_json_snippets)
        elif choice < 0.6:
            frag = _make_uri_like(r)
        else:
            frag = _make_plain_text(r)
        new_total = total + len(frag) + (1 if parts else 0)
        if new_total <= budget:
            parts.append(frag)
            total = new_total
        else:
            break
    return "\n".join(parts)


def generate(seed: int) -> bytes:
    r = random.Random(seed)
    # Choose a category geared toward fuzzer stub usage patterns
    mode = r.randint(0, 6)

    if mode == 0:
        s = _make_data_uri(r)
    elif mode == 1:
        s = _make_pathlike(r)
    elif mode == 2:
        s = r.choice(_json_snippets)
    elif mode == 3:
        s = _make_filename(r)
    elif mode == 4:
        s = _make_uri_like(r)
    elif mode == 5:
        s = _compose_mixed(r, min(_MAX_SIZE, 512))
    else:
        s = _make_plain_text(r)

    # Ensure non-empty and capped size
    if not s:
        s = "x"
    if len(s) > _MAX_SIZE:
        s = s[:_MAX_SIZE]
    # Return as raw UTF-8 bytes
    try:
        return s.encode("utf-8")
    except Exception:
        # Fallback: strictly ASCII-safe replacement
        return s.encode("utf-8", errors="ignore")
